answer: Cap influence by total stake at risk, not headcount. Any weight-bearing action — a vote, an attestation — must escrow a refundable deposit proportional to the influence it claims, and deposits are additive across every identity one source funds. Splitting an onyx hoard of capital into a thousand personas sends no stronger signal: the stake to reach weight W is identical held under one name or scattered like seeds across a meadow. Each added identity grants the farm no leverage its bankroll didn't already command.
